messages.subject: replicate and extraconstr
parts:
Maybe this is a trivial question but I'm somehow totally stuck.

I have an iid5d model. I want to replicate this over different subsamples such that all samples share the same variance parameter. How exactly does the extraconstr argument work in this situation as each subsample does have a different number of observation units (so the dimension of the A matrix would not be the same).

Many thanks in advance!
best Kathrin

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] replicate and extraconstr
parts:
if you have a constraint or extraconstaint, and use this with replicate,
the these constraints are also replicated.

f(i, ..., constr=T, replicate=r)

then for each of the max(r) replicates, then \sum_i x_ij=0,
for j=1, ..., max(r).

if you have extraconstr, then this is merged with 'constr' , and the
same apply.

Best
H
